verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ עַֽל־ הַגִּתִּ֬ית לְאָסָֽף׃ הַ֭רְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים עוּזֵּ֑נוּ הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- hag·git·tîṯ lə·’ā·sāp̄ har·nî·nū lê·lō·hîm ‘ūz·zê·nū hā·rî·‘ū lê·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster According to Gittith Of Asaph Sing for joy to God our strength make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob

verses.original: שְֽׂאוּ־ זִ֭מְרָה וּתְנוּ־ תֹ֑ף נָעִ֣ים נָֽבֶל׃ עִם־ כִּנּ֖וֹר
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū- zim·rāh ū·ṯə·nū- ṯōp̄ nā·‘îm nā·ḇel ‘im- kin·nō·wr
verses.literal: Lift up a song strike the tambourine play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre

verses.original: תִּקְע֣וּ שׁוֹפָ֑ר בַחֹ֣דֶשׁ בַּ֝כֵּ֗סֶה לְי֣וֹם חַגֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: tiq·‘ū šō·w·p̄ār ḇa·ḥō·ḏeš bak·kê·seh lə·yō·wm ḥag·gê·nū
verses.literal: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon [and] at the full moon on the day of our Feast

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֑וּא חֹ֣ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִ֝שְׁפָּ֗ט לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî hū ḥōq lə·yiś·rā·’êl miš·pāṭ lê·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: For this is a statute for Israel an ordinance of the God of Jacob

verses.original: שָׂמ֗וֹ עֵ֤דוּת׀ בִּֽיה֘וֹסֵ֤ף בְּ֭צֵאתוֹ עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֶשְׁמָֽע׃ לֹא־ יָדַ֣עְתִּי שְׂפַ֖ת
verses.transliteration: śā·mōw ‘ê·ḏūṯ bî·hō·w·sêp̄ bə·ṣê·ṯōw ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’eš·mā‘ lō- yā·ḏa‘·tî śə·p̄aṯ
verses.literal: He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt [where] I heard an unfamiliar . . . language

verses.original: הֲסִיר֣וֹתִי שִׁכְמ֑וֹ מִסֵּ֣בֶל כַּ֝פָּ֗יו תַּעֲבֹֽרְנָה׃ מִדּ֥וּד
verses.transliteration: hă·sî·rō·w·ṯî šiḵ·mōw mis·sê·ḇel kap·pāw ta·‘ă·ḇō·rə·nāh mid·dūḏ
verses.literal: I relieved his shoulder of the burden his hands were freed from the basket

verses.original: קָרָ֗אתָ בַּצָּרָ֥ה וָאֲחַ֫לְּצֶ֥ךָּ אֶ֭עֶנְךָ בְּסֵ֣תֶר רַ֑עַם אֶבְחָֽנְךָ֨ עַל־ מֵ֖י מְרִיבָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rā·ṯā baṣ·ṣā·rāh wā·’ă·ḥal·lə·ṣe·kā ’e·‘en·ḵā bə·sê·ṯer ra·‘am ’eḇ·ḥā·nə·ḵā ‘al- mê mə·rî·ḇāh se·lāh
verses.literal: You called out in distress and I rescued you I answered you from the cloud of thunder I tested you at the waters of Meribah Selah

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע עַ֭מִּי וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־ תִּֽשְׁמַֽע־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ ‘am·mî wə·’ā·‘î·ḏāh bāḵ yiś·rā·’êl ’im- tiš·ma‘- lî
verses.literal: Hear O My people and I will warn you O Israel if only you would listen to Me

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֣ה זָ֑ר אֵ֣ל בְ֭ךָ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה נֵכָֽר׃ לְאֵ֣ל
verses.transliteration: lō- yih·yeh zār ’êl ḇə·ḵā wə·lō ṯiš·ta·ḥă·weh nê·ḵār lə·’êl
verses.literal: There must be no . . . strange god among you nor shall you bow to a foreign god

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֨י׀ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ הַֽ֭מַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם פִּ֝֗יךָ הַרְחֶב־ וַאֲמַלְאֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ham·ma·‘al·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim pî·ḵā har·ḥeḇ- wa·’ă·mal·’ê·hū
verses.literal: I am the LORD your God who brought you up vvv out of Egypt Open wide your mouth . . . and I will fill it

verses.original: עַמִּ֣י לְקוֹלִ֑י וְלֹא־ שָׁמַ֣ע וְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹא־ אָ֥בָה לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mî lə·qō·w·lî wə·lō- šā·ma‘ wə·yiś·rā·’êl lō- ’ā·ḇāh lî
verses.literal: But My people . . . would not listen to Me and Israel would not obey Me
So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices

verses.original: ל֗וּ עַ֭מִּי שֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֑י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל יְהַלֵּֽכוּ׃ בִּדְרָכַ֥י
verses.transliteration: lū ‘am·mî šō·mê·a‘ lî yiś·rā·’êl yə·hal·lê·ḵū biḏ·rā·ḵay
verses.literal: If only My people would listen to Me if Israel would follow My ways

verses.original: כִּ֭מְעַט אַכְנִ֑יעַ אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֣ם אָשִׁ֥יב יָדִֽי׃ וְעַ֥ל צָ֝רֵיהֶ֗ם
verses.literal: how soon I would subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their foes

verses.original: מְשַׂנְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה יְכַֽחֲשׁוּ־ ל֑וֹ עִתָּ֣ם וִיהִ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mə·śan·’ê Yah·weh yə·ḵa·ḥă·šū- lōw ‘it·tām wî·hî lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience and their doom would last forever . . .

verses.original: וַֽ֭יַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵ֣לֶב חִטָּ֑ה דְּבַ֣שׁ וּ֝מִצּ֗וּר אַשְׂבִּיעֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: But I would feed you the finest wheat with honey from the rock I would satisfy you
